status: Frozen before company rankings or target valuation outcomes are inspected
candidate_universe: The team's 534 website-eligible companies, excluding self; failures are retained and not replaced

activity_transport.mass: uniform over independently extracted supported activities; textual scope, not revenue weights

financial_rank.information_regime: mentor-permitted financial augmentation; definition/date quality unresolved

peer_policies.abstention: require supported activity evidence in target and all five selected peers; coverage guard, not a calibrated relevance threshold

valuation.target_outcomes: opened only after rank artifacts are hashed
valuation.strict_aligned_mode: unavailable until dates and definitions are confirmed

direct_valuation_challengers.status: Predeclared additional predictive arms; do not rank business relevance

direct_valuation_challengers.training: all non-target eligible companies with positive finite multiples; ten targets excluded as a group
direct_valuation_challengers.limits: Small undated cross-section, no temporal backtest or calibrated prediction interval
